item.title: Oct 10, 2026 — Deep dive: Heat is the real wall in orbit
item.description: Each megawatt of orbital compute needs roughly 1,000 m² of radiator and 3,000 m² of solar array, so launch cost per kg decides whether space data centers beat the ground. Plus: humanoid shipments, GraphRAG benchmarks, this week's Nobels, CRM valuation, India AI funding.
